$comment: Copy to relay.config.json (or point RELAY_CONFIG at a file like this) to run the gateway in routed mode. API keys are NEVER written here: apiKeyEnv names an environment variable the gateway reads at dispatch time. Prices are USD per 1k tokens and feed the cash book (src/ledger.js). Every model carries a capability grade (light|standard|heavy) for the difficulty axis: the router only sends a task to models graded at or above the task's classified level (see docs/DIFFICULTY-REPORT.md). A bare string model entry is still accepted and grades as 'standard'. An upstream may declare quotaSource to pick its quota source: 'codex-usage' reads remaining quota from Codex's official usage endpoint (both windows; the tighter one leads), with the credential taken from the local Codex sign-in (~/.codex/auth.json, or env RELAY_CODEX_AUTH) at fetch time — it is never written into this file. Without quotaSource, the quota block's own source applies ('mock' / 'metering' / 'unavailable').
